answer: Work waits on the jetty until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ferrous of the next round. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. By the summit of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
